errors.evidence: The countries on the horizontal axis are not sorted alphabetically. They are sorted in ascending order of the total height of their respective bars. For example, 'Белгия' (Belgium) appears after 'Чехия' (Czechia), which breaks Bulgarian alphabetical order.

errors.text_span: За всяка държава колоните показват постепенно увеличаване на общата височина през годините
errors.evidence: This is a fundamental misinterpretation of the chart. There is only one column per country, representing a total value aggregated from 2016-2020. The chart does not show an increase in height 'over the years' for any single country. The visual effect of increasing height is across different countries, from left to right, due to the sorting.

errors.text_span: но може да се предположи, че
errors.evidence: The description makes an assumption ('it can be assumed that'), which violates the prompt's instruction to avoid interpretations and conclusions.

errors.text_span: стойностите са кумулативни за всяка година
errors.evidence: This incorrectly describes how to read a stacked bar chart. The height of each colored segment represents the value for that specific year, not a cumulative value. The total height of the bar is the sum of the five individual yearly values.

errors.text_span: Държавите са подредени по азбучен ред на техните имена на български език.
errors.evidence: This repeats the incorrect claim about the sorting order that was already mentioned at the beginning of the description.
